source_topic: First list #34: Discovering Novel Cellulases for Biofuel Production
title: Metagenome-scale discovery of divergent candidate cellulases for lignocellulosic biofuel processing
question: Does the MGnify metagenomic protein catalog contain glycoside-hydrolase cellulase homologs that (a) retain the catalytic machinery of characterized cellulase GH families, (b) carry cellulase-family Pfam domains, (c) are substantially sequence-divergent from every experimentally characterized cellulase in the reference panel, and (d) retain structural template support in the PDB?
claims_boundary: Computational nomination only. No enzymatic activity is claimed for any candidate; no wet-lab validation was performed. Candidates are ranked hypotheses for experimental follow-up in biofuel enzyme-cocktail development.

reference_set.definition: 15 experimentally characterized cellulases across CAZy families GH3, GH5, GH6, GH7, GH9, GH12, GH45, GH48, each verified live in UniProtKB with active-site features, Pfam cross-references and (mostly) PDB structures; mature sequences (signal peptide removed where annotated).

search.engine: phmmer via EBI HMMER API v1
search.database: MGnify30-C2 - Non-singletons (version recorded at run time)
search.queries: 15 mature reference cellulases (primary) + 3 decoy hydrolases (specificity control), identical settings
search.collection_rule: all hits with E-value <= 1e-5 to at least one reference, union across references, deduplicated by MGYP accession; decoy hits kept in a SEPARATE pool

filters.F1_length: 180 <= length <= 900 amino acids (covers the reference panel span 213-880 aa including multi-domain cellulases)
filters.F2_domain: candidate Pfam annotations (MGnify hit metadata) must include at least one catalytic cellulase-GH Pfam family from the locked set {PF00150 GH5, PF01341 GH6, PF00840 GH7, PF00759 GH9, PF01670 GH12, PF02015 GH45, PF02011 GH48, PF01915 GH3}; candidates with no Pfam annotation are recorded as not-evaluable and excluded from gate counts
filters.F3_homology: minimum phmmer E-value across the 15 references <= 1e-10
filters.F4_novelty: maximum global pairwise identity to any of the 15 references < 40%; Biopython PairwiseAligner global, BLOSUM62, open -11, extend -1; identity = identical positions / alignment columns
filters.F6_catalytic: using the phmmer aligned-FASTA (afa) of the candidate's best reference hit that has UniProt ACT_SITE annotation, EVERY annotated catalytic position must align to Asp or Glu in the candidate; candidates whose reference hits all lack ACT_SITE annotation are recorded not-evaluable and excluded from gate counts
filters.F5_structure: top 50 F1-F4+F6 survivors by E-value: RCSB sequence search E <= 1e-10 plus local-alignment coverage >= 60% of candidate length

positive_controls.C1: >= 85% of the 15 references must pass F1 (validates the length window)
positive_controls.C3: decoy-derived pools (xylanase, lysozyme, amylase queries) screened with IDENTICAL F1,F2,F3,F4,F6 filters must yield <= 10% as many gate-counted candidates as the reference pool (specificity)

all_required: G1: reference build contains >= 12 live-verified characterized cellulases (met: 15)
G2: >= 40 distinct MGnify candidates pass F1, F2, F3, F4 and F6
G3: >= 15 of the G2 candidates have novelty < 30% to every reference
G4: >= 15 of the top-50 candidates examined in F5 have RCSB template E <= 1e-10 with >= 60% coverage
G5: >= 5 G2 candidates have aliphatic index >= the reference-panel median AND >= 2 cysteine residues
G6: decoy pools yield <= 10% as many gate-counted candidates as the reference pool

sensitivity_analyses: candidate counts at F4 novelty thresholds 25/30/35/40 percent
candidate counts at F3 E-value thresholds 1e-5 / 1e-10 / 1e-20
failure_policy: If any required gate fails, classify SP-004 as negative, preserve all raw artifacts, hit tables, rejected sets and figures, and do not produce a success paper.
leakage_controls: gate and thresholds locked before any hit table is inspected
reference panel fixed before searching; Pfam catalytic set fixed from the panel's own live annotations
raw API responses hashed (SHA-256) at download; results derive only from hashed artifacts
decoy pools processed identically but counted separately; no simulated data

provenance.artifacts: data/raw/** with per-file SHA-256; HMMER job UUIDs in results/run_manifest*.json
